hero.title: Slow Horses S6 — Season Premiere
hero.date: Wed Sep 16, 2026 — Ep 1 live now, weekly Wednesdays through Oct 21
hero.about: Season 6 adapts Mick Herron's Joe Country and Slough House. Ep 1 'Circle of Life' finds the Slow Horses on the run as Diana Taverner drags them into a fatal game of retaliation and revenge. Gary Oldman, Jack Lowden and Olivia Cooke return; BAFTA winner Lenny Rush joins the ensemble.
hero.why: Loved-list series that stops the presses. Ep 1 debuted at 100% on Rotten Tomatoes — a new series record (8.9/10 average across 10+ reviews). The prior five seasons have all sat at 100%. Six 55-min episodes weekly is a perfect bedtime cadence. This is the event of the month.
